The Uber Knight's Most Extreme
Class:  Fighter

The Uber Knight's Most Extreme is a fighter rainbow item.

This item is soulbound.

Attributes:

No fixed bonuses are known beyond the rainbow name itself.

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
